notes: No past-tense participle or adjective whose subject is the player, another player or a {name} (gender unknown): nouns, present tense or impersonal forms instead.
Placeholders take no case endings: they follow a colon or stand in apposition to a declined noun (zgradu {building}, igraču {arg1}).
Plural categories one/few/other per Intl.PluralRules("hr") (1 ratnik, 2 ratnika, 5 ratnika; 21 ratnik).
Generated names need generatedNames: noun-first. Second parts are capitalised nouns (Vrh, Dolina), first parts invariant lowercase genitives (groma, magle): Vrh groma, Dolina magle, Ždral tišine.
Croatian uses č ć đ š ž, outside Latin-1, so activating it needs SYSTEM_FONT_LANGS (latin-fonts test fails until then).
ui.your_purchase_been_delivered_6f88dee143 and ui.s_have_bced00a61e are a legacy English fragment pair (purchase + " has"/"s have"); they cannot be rendered grammatically in Croatian.
Japanese legal pages are translated into Croatian, as in the other completed languages.
